2026_03_LV_NO.headline: Las Vegas and New Orleans chase offensive stability in a matchup of pressure points
2026_03_LV_NO.paragraph1: Las Vegas and New Orleans both have incentives to keep this game out of obvious passing situations, where protection breakdowns can quickly flip field position. The Raiders need their run game and quick passing concepts to create rhythm before attacking deeper coverage. The Saints can answer by varying pressure and forcing the ball underneath, then asking their offense to finish drives rather than settling for empty possession. Whichever team handles third down and red-zone snaps more cleanly should control the game.
2026_03_LV_NO.model_rationale: Both offenses benefit from staying on schedule, making third-down protection and red-zone execution more important than raw yardage in deciding which side can sustain scoring drives.
